# KlivIQ Technologies

> Boutique tech studio delivering AI implementation, fractional CTO services, and high-performance web/mobile/AI tools. India-based, globally positioned. Fixed pricing, delivery in weeks.

KlivIQ helps businesses implement AI and build software. Services include AI integration (chatbots, automation, intelligent dashboards), fractional CTO engagements, web and mobile app development, and custom AI tools.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Services, work, pricing, FAQ, and contact for KlivIQ Technologies.
- [ScopeSnap](/scopesnap): AI tool that turns a project brief into a complete scope of work, cost estimate, timeline, and tech stack.
- [ClinicPing](/clinicping): AI-powered clinic management demo — appointment reminders, no-show prediction, patient communication.
- [PitchDeck AI](/pitchdeck): Generates investor pitch decks from a business idea in English plus Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam.
